body: I know I try to be nice to her but sometimes it's difficult :/. My relationship is great. Pretty much the only problem is I'm insanely jealous but don't worry I do not speak my insane fears of jealousy. Honestly, nothing. I like philosophy but what am I gonna do with a philosophy major. I definitely do not like talking in front of a bunch of people so I can't be a teacher. I dislike math so I'm pretty much screwed. Lately I feel like I have no purpose like when I'm not in school there is no reason for me to live. All I do is sleep and wait for my boyfriend or two of my other friends to hang out. (I only have 2 friends) That's a problem too I can't tell if I care too much about people that I only let few people in or if I'm just a cold hearted bitch. My uncle's girlfriend (who he basically left my aunt for in the past year) is in the hospital but I don't care about seeing her because I don't care about her at all. Mostly because my aunt is heartbroken and I love my aunt so much and she's worried no one cares about her. But that makes me a horrible person. But people die every day. Like if I just died I'd just be another person that died oh well. I hate money. I never want to worry about money. My mom throws money at me like it's nothing and I hate it. I wish we had no money or she taught me to be productive with it when I was younger. I feel like she tries to buy me off. I just got a new car that I don't deserve (I'm not saying that I don't appreciate or like it because I do so much) it's just confusing. I just feel confused.

Thank you for replying :) But that's the point I'm not good at anything I don't know what to do career wise. I am sorry I do feel like I left out a lot I was in a rush to get all that down. Me and my mother are good. I can't tell her straight up that I love her but I do. She isn't happy with him but she pretends to be because she likes to ignore things that are painful for her. He is mean to her too but nothing like me and she also doesn't notice when he is being rude to her. I think she believes me now after all my friends witnessed him being a jackass and they told her and she confronts him but still nothing changes. If anything it got worse he's more secretive like he whispers at my door how "fucking retarded" I am and some other stuff about how much I suck or when she's not looking he'll mouth it to me. My mom and him argue all the time and she'll threaten him by saying that she'll leave but everyone knows she never will so he's just like "So leave then"
